name: Post-Earnings Short Straddle / Strangle (IV Crush Sale)
summary: Sell a straddle or strangle immediately after an earnings announcement to capture the collapse in implied volatility once the uncertainty is resolved - the two-sided companion to the bank's post-earnings short put.

legs.strike_rule: delta 0.20-0.30 measured AFTER the print, or ATM for the straddle version
legs.dte_rule: the first monthly expiry after the event, 21-45 DTE

legs.strike_rule: |delta| 0.20-0.30 after the print (or the same ATM strike for the straddle)

max_profit: The net credit received, if the underlying settles between the strikes
max_loss: UNDEFINED in the naked form: unlimited above the call strike and (strike x 100 - credit) below the put strike
breakevens: lower = put strike - credit per share; upper = call strike + credit per share

greeks.gamma: negative, and post-earnings drift is a real phenomenon
greeks.vega: negative - the crush is the trade

typical_dte: 21-45 DTE, entered the session after the announcement
when_to_use: INCLUDED FOR COMPLETENESS - THE NAKED FORM IS NOT TRADEABLE AT LEVEL 3. The crush is real and immediate, but it is also the most-competed trade on the tape: most of it is priced into the first fifteen minutes of the following session.
entry_rules: BLOCKED in its naked form: both legs uncovered, requires Alpaca options level 4.

LEVEL 3 SUBSTITUTE (the only permitted version): sell the same two strikes wrapped as a SHORT IRON CONDOR - add a long call above and a long put below, each $5-$10 wide. Credit falls by roughly a third; the loss becomes defined and the structure becomes tradeable here. Use the bank's iron-condor entry with these earnings-specific gates layered on top.
Enter no earlier than 15 minutes after the open on the session following the announcement - the first minutes are where the crush already happened and where the spreads are widest.
IV gate: post-print ATM IV must still be >= the 60th percentile of the name's 1-year IV range. If IV has already normalized, the trade is gone.
Strikes must sit outside the actual post-earnings move: both shorts at least 1.0 x the realized gap away from the new spot.
No entry in a name that gapped more than 12% - post-earnings drift in violent movers overwhelms the premium.
Defined risk per name <= 1% of equity; at most 2 post-earnings positions at once.
management_rules: Take profit at 50% of credit - and expect to reach it fast; most of the crush is realized within 2 sessions.
Time stop at 21 DTE or 10 calendar days after entry, whichever comes first. This trade has no reason to be held for a month.
Close the tested side when its short delta reaches 0.30; do not roll it into the drift.
Never re-enter the same name in the same earnings cycle after a stop.
exit_rules: Force-close every leg by 15:45 ET on expiration day.
Close any short leg at extrinsic < $0.10, |delta| >= 0.85, or when ITM by more than 0.25 x its wing width.
Ex-dividend guard on the short call before every ex-date while it is ITM.
If the naked version is ever enabled at level 4, all of the above still applies plus a hard close at the first touch of either short strike.
assignment_risk: Two short legs in a single name immediately after its most volatile event of the quarter. In the permitted iron-condor form each short is covered by a long wing, so the loss is defined - but assignment still delivers 100 shares of a name that just gapped, and post-earnings drift means the tested side keeps being tested.
buying_power: Naked form: full naked margin on both sides (level 4). Permitted form: (wing width x 100) - credit, held on one side.
liquidity_needs: Single-name chains are at their widest the morning after earnings; require OI >= 500 per leg and be willing to skip on spread alone.
common_mistakes: Selling into the print instead of after it; expecting the crush when IV has already normalized; running it naked; holding for the full credit when 90% of the crush arrived in 48 hours.
zero_dte_notes: Not appropriate - single-name 0DTE after earnings is pure gap risk with no premium to justify it.
family: Completeness gap-fill (cross-family): ratio/naked-financed put and call structures, quantity-unbalanced condors and strangles, stock+option overlays and monetizations, capital-protection and hybrid builds, 0DTE four-leg income, volatility-surface and relative-value trades, event-driven overlays, and roll/adjustment structures
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
